items.titulo: SpaceX locks in $40B GPU financing deal with Apollo
items.resumen: SpaceX has locked in a binding commitment for roughly $40 billion in financing to pay for AI chips and related data center equipment, the company disclosed in a regulatory filing Monday. In a statement, SpaceX called it the “largest committed GPU financing” ever.

items.titulo: Tsinghua AI Open-Sources AKV, a Cache Engineering Server for LLM Agents on SGLang
items.resumen: Tsinghua researchers released AKV, an SGLang-based serving system for cache engineering. LLM agents drop and reposition KV cache instead of summarizing history, cutting average cost 27.7% across 4 agent benchmarks.
